package.description: Create and present photo slideshows on nearby devices over Wi-Fi.

en-US.description: Create and present photo slideshows on nearby devices over Wi-Fi.
en-US.longDescription: Gallery Remote lets you create an ordered selection of photos and present it as a slideshow on a paired phone, tablet, Mac, or Windows PC over a local network or Wi-Fi. You can arrange the images and control the slideshow from either device.
en-US.name: Gallery Remote
